body: well TLD never been fast :) the way is is originally designed it cant run fast without such things like multiprocessor usage and SSE optimizations. unfortunately. the fern based detection is really nice technique (quite memory expensive though) but i will recommend to look into http://cvlab.epfl.ch/software/ferns/index.php original implementation that runs a lot faster and my personal opinion it is more accurate.
